name: menu
accessibility: role=menu: opening focuses the first item, Up/Down and Home/End move, Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger. Shortcut hints are hidden from screen readers.
example:
<Menu trigger={<Button variant="outline">Actions</Button>}>
  <MenuGroup label="Project">
    <MenuItem icon={<Copy />} shortcut="⌘C" onClick={copyLink}>Copy link</MenuItem>
  </MenuGroup>
  <MenuSeparator />
  <MenuItem variant="danger" onClick={remove}>Delete project</MenuItem>
</Menu>
